notes.title: My Journey with Dome Discover: A Temporary Goodbye Filled with Gratitude
notes.content:
When I started working on Dome Discover, I dreamed of creating something unique—something that would not only represent my love for video games and anime but also everything I could offer as a person and a creator. I dedicated six years full of effort, creativity, and yes, even a bit of madness. It meant sleepless nights, a lot of money invested, and countless doubts, but also moments of discovery and learning that helped me grow in ways I could never have imagined.

Today, I want to share something important:[b] I’ve decided to put Dome Discover on pause[/b]. This wasn’t an easy decision. I have an immense love for what I built and for those who supported me through different stages of the project. However, I’ve reached a point in my life where I need to rethink how I want to move forward, take a breath, and focus on smaller, personal creations that reflect who I am today.

For a long time, I thought that if I didn’t finish Dome Discover the way I envisioned, it would feel like a failure. But now I understand that it wasn’t. Everything I learned and accomplished with this project opened doors I didn’t even know existed. Today, thanks to Dome Discover, I’m working on something big that allows me to live off what I love, rest, and enjoy a balance I haven’t had in years.

For now, I’m putting Dome Discover on hold. I’m not sure if I’ll return to it in the future, even though I still have so many ideas for it. What I do know is that I’m deeply grateful for it. This project taught me more than I could have ever imagined and brought me to places I always dreamed of. To all of you who played, supported, or simply believed in me, I owe you an enormous thank you.

This isn’t a definitive goodbye. It’s just a “see you later” while I keep growing, exploring, and giving my best on this creative journey.

Thank you, Dome Discover. And thank you to all of you.

notes.title: Dome Discover: Our debut at the PlayJam and our plans for the future.
notes.content:
Greetings to everyone! I am very happy to share with you the news of Dome Discover. Last Saturday we participated in our first event, the PlayJam, here in Argentina, where we presented our proposal and received excellent feedback. It was an amazing experience and it motivated us to continue with the first alpha for steam. Our goal is to incorporate the suggestions that they made us at the event and polish some details. We estimate that in a month and a half we will be ready to launch the early access stage again. We know that you have waited a lot, but we assure you that we have not stopped working hard and that we have overcome many obstacles along the way. Now that I have everything in order, I'm still here, giving my best to make Dome Discover a reality.

notes.title: *** Mr. MASITO ***

It is a large metal mace, made by Elizabeth's husband a few months before he died. Of great weight and strengths, it can speak due to the fact that it received part of the essence and soul of its creator, so it is a strong mirror of her husband. His color is gray: it denotes melancholy, sadness, memories of better days...
Thanks to https://www.facebook.com/EHimitsu for her artwork!

notes.title: *** ELIZABETH ***
notes.content:
Saleswoman of the community. After seeing all the children in the village became orphans, she took the decision and responsibility to take care of them. She is characterized by her great kindness, compassion and love. Her distinctive color is blue: for her faithfulness, serenity, optimism, freshness, calmness. She is the grandmother that everyone would like to have!
Thanks to https://www.facebook.com/EHimitsu for her artwork!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38982721/f730fc723e26f60c6d69a2a72a7ba6f3320aa9d8.png[/img]

notes.title: *** MAGNUS ***
notes.content:
Former archer, but due to the lack of magicians in the village, he had to change his profession. He has a strong personality, seriousness and wisdom, but also a great stubbornness and arrogance. This causes some fear and respect in the youngest. His characteristic color is violet: for elegance, fights fear and brings peace.
Thanks to https://www.facebook.com/EHimitsu for her artwork!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38982721/3884a34e31d8537fcde9df19340e7ccd4e720f08.png[/img]

notes.title: *** ELRIC ***
notes.content:
Friendly, cheerful and joyful. He cheers up anyone who is sad, tries to keep high the self-esteem of all the people. 
His color is orange: for his radiant and expansive strength.
Thanks to https://www.facebook.com/EHimitsu for his artwork!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38982721/eece25cf514f46ed1b6d52cc527908da22e9eab8.png[/img]

notes.title: *** WILLIAM ***
notes.content:
A carpenter by trade, but for lack of blacksmiths he had to learn the noble art of blacksmithing since there were none. 
Warm, calm and lover of art and his work. His colors are strong green ( because of his safety) and brown (balance). 
Thanks to https://www.facebook.com/EHimitsu for his art!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38982721/50ef8c86495ac8e383c84cbf8ce25b5421c9327b.png[/img]

notes.title: *** ANNE ***
notes.content:
Aeon's childhood friend. Quiet, kind and sensitive. Although very shy and frightened. Because of her blindness, she learned to hear the plants to move around the dome. Her color is green: it encourages balance by being calm and relaxing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38982721/95b6e43b597d936b33c71f3b6ff9fed57f29e5ec.png[/img]

notes.title: *** MARIE ***
notes.content:
She is full of energy and cheerful, although somewhat perverse and harmful. She is a librarian and collects information from the dome by transcribing it into books. Her characteristic color is amalgam of red (for her passion), violet (for her mystery) and blue (for her intelligence).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38982721/835451e77af5c1dae0e3e4dce2d0cd0d54c74951.png[/img]

notes.content:
Aeon's close friend, his main characteristic is to sleep and be lazy and this bothers some of his family members. You never know what he has in mind until he finally does something, which, surprisingly, has logic. His color is lilac: for the impact he wants to generate: peace and balance.

notes.title: ***LET´S INTRODUCE OURSELVES***
notes.content:
Hi! my name is Luis Angel Espinosa I am a Mexican digital Animator, I was in contact with visual arts all my life because cartoons, videogames and cinema made an impact on my life since I was a child and not only as a fan of the stories and characters, but also as a deep respect to the designers and to the techniques.
The beginning of my education as a digital artist started when I began to study photography, to later take a technical career in graphic design, which was important to realize that I really wanted to take it beyond and study digital animation as my main career.
Over the course of my career I have worked in several areas of audiovisual production, from 3d products modeling, to direction of photography in music videos and short films, which apparently have no relation with animation but I noticed that the essence of being an animator is to resolve issues and find options to achieve  what you are aiming for, since in most cases there is no specific manual to do it, or maybe doesn't even exist yet.
I'm strongly influenced by video games like Halo, Half life, GTA and animations like Courage the cowardly dog, but also all the pixar stuff. 
 About myself I can say that I have quite common hobbies, I like playing guitar, skateboarding and motorsports, I'm also very fond of motorcycles and sometimes I also create content for youtube.

notes.title: LET´S INTRODUCE OURSELVES TO YOU
notes.content:
]Hi, I'm Rosario Puche, even though I'm known as Blackpara. I have been playing video games since I was 3 years old and I was fascinated by how by simply pressing a few buttons the character moved on the screen. That made me love videogames and I decided to create them. So I studied programming. Due to economic problems I had to drop out of the career, today I work in other areas of systems and I dedicate myself to self-development. After seeing that my Latin American colleagues were forming their own ways with videogame development companies, I said to myself: If there are no job opportunities nearby, I must create them. My dream is to form a team of people from all over Latin American countries, where people can work without having to move from their own countries.

notes.title: Urgent update (V 0.2.0b).
notes.content:
We made a last minute change: we have modified and fixed a bug which made it impossible for the player to keep playing. When loading the map and selecting the M button it did not allow you to return to the current game.
We apologize for the inconveniences this may have caused.

notes.title: New update: 0.2.0 a
notes.content:
As we have already mentioned this will only be  bug fixes. 
The following changes were made to the game: 

[list]
[*] We made Slime more tame for the early part of the game.
[*] We have improved the help messages so that the player can be guided in a  better way.
[*] We implement button M to see the level map.
[*] We lowered the brightness of the level a bit. What do you think about it?
[*] Fixes of small bugs such as buttons that were stuck, no texts or annoying camera are seen in small insides.
[*] Change of  stones location.
[/list]

From now on we will dedicate ourselves to add more content to the game. Remember that you can see our weekly posts & updates on our social networks.

We thank all of you!!!

notes.title: And time has come.
notes.content:
Hello everybody! I am here to announce that the marketing and launch stage was a complete success. Well... a success for a person who has just started in this career, so it's time to time to roll up our sleeves and begin the new stage: fix bugs.


Gameplay:

[list]
[*] I have noticed my blunder: "not adding a combat tutorial". In future updates, Kyrie will help us
[*] (our teacher), and will take us through the teachings of the art of battle.
[*] The battle system seems to be my weakness, so I will focus on this.
[*] Improve the healing potions, notice that they loaded very little. So we will make them load more!
[*] We will improve the indoor camera. For sure we will fix it as it is very frustrating for the player.
[*] Improve the maps and quest guides.
[*] Improve the sales system
[*] Campfires to rest? It is a good idea, we will consider it
[*]Little bugs* as transfers of objects, we have already marked many.
[/list]

Thank you very much for your help. I really feel very alive, and I feel like I can start typing fiercely. There is still too much to improve!

PS: there will be an upcoming surprise. I hope you like it.
